response.text:
I can do that, but deleting rows is irreversible so I need a bit more before I proceed.

Please confirm the sheet and deletion criteria, and choose one of these options:

1) Backup then permanently delete matching rows.
2) Move matching rows to a new sheet named "Imported - tests (backup)" (reversible).
3) Show a preview of the rows that would be deleted (first 20) so you can approve.

Also tell me:
- The sheet name (e.g., "Leads") — I don't have it open yet.
- How to identify "test" rows (examples: Name contains "test", email like test@..., phone is all zeros, source = "import", created before a certain date). If you want me to infer common patterns I can, but I prefer an explicit rule to avoid removing real data.

I will preserve formulas and structure unless you tell me to overwrite them. Tell me which option you want and the identification rule, and I’ll proceed. I won’t send any notifications unless you ask.
